name: plan-china-medium-council
description: The Chinese Medium Council (0.8.3): an alternative route next to the three planning chains (plan-mini-council, plan-medium-council, plan-high-council), not a replacement for any of them. It runs the planning stages with four proposers (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, MiMo V2.6 Pro, GLM-5.3 Flash, Tencent HY4 Preview), an alternatives stage (GLM-5.3 Flash, MiMo V2.6 Pro and Tencent HY4 Preview; every proposer also debates the architectures), one deep-dive seat (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash) and a layered review panel of six named judges in three layers: layer 1 GLM-5.3 Flash, MiMo V2.6 Pro; layer 2 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, StepFun Step 5 Preview; layer 3 Qwen 3.8 Max and Tencent HY4 Preview. Every proposer, alternatives seat, deep-dive seat and judge is a model from a Chinese lab. Tencent HY4 Preview and StepFun Step 5 Preview are preview models. plan-medium-council has seven judges; this chain has six. Exactly these six vote, six judges from six companies; DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, MiMo V2.6 Pro, GLM-5.3 Flash and Tencent HY4 Preview each both propose and judge, which is why "judging" is "all-roles". Every layer has at least two judges. A layer is asked only when every layer below it signed off, and a layer signs off when all its judges do. Any objection at a lower layer sends the draft to the reviser and the climb starts again at layer 1; a round ends only when layer 3 gives its verdict, a sign-off or an objection. This chain allows 3 such overseer rounds (maxOverseerRounds) and, inside one round, 2 revisions of layer 1 and 1 of layer 2 (layerRevisions). When either limit is reached the run stops, resumable and NOT agreed, and you choose: continue (it extends the limit that was reached; the run's spending limit still applies), or finish (the dispute stage and the handoff run and the result stays "not agreed"), or revise the draft yourself. answer_back is on: a judge's own earlier objection is shown back to it, and only that judge can close it. The criteria stage is answered through your Claude subscription (the Opus 5.5 seat, `provider: external`). The skeleton, build, revise, handoff and decider stages are answered by your Claude Code session (`provider: external`). A stage that waits for an external answer pauses the run with exit code 3 until it is answered. These Claude-backed stages are the only exceptions to the Chinese-model roster. Every API seat reasons at high, or at the model's own default where that is higher (the harness sends these no effort setting: GLM-5.3 Flash at max, Qwen 3.8 Max at xhigh); no Grok, no Kimi, no Mistral. Output caps are the largest reply the harness knows for each model: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 393,216; MiMo V2.6 Pro, GLM-5.3 Flash and Qwen 3.8 Max 131,072; Tencent HY4 Preview and StepFun Step 5 Preview 64,000. Dry run (0.8.3, prices of 2026-10-23, the dry run's assumed sizes): $5.78 expected (every overseer round ends after one climb through the layers) and an upper estimate of $17.71 (every allowed revision used in every overseer round), about $5.78 plus a Claude subscription. The upper estimate leaves out the in-pass re-asks (up to 2 per seat), up to 2 consecutive passes that re-ask a silent seat, the explicit asks of a silent judge, answer-back calls, the memory block judge calls read from overseer round 2 on (up to 10000 tokens per call, paid input that neither figure prices) and the larger prompt the top layer reads, so it is not a ceiling: the limit you type is what stops spending. No proposer's cap is below the most the harness will retry its model at, so a proposal cut off at its cap is not asked again with a bigger one. The upper estimate ($17.71) is above the default cap of $7. On the command line that cap is only a suggestion. The Claude Desktop bundle's default Spend ceiling of $10 is a hard ceiling nobody can type above, so with that default a run that uses its whole allowance stops at the ceiling (the expected figure and the cheapest end, $5.07, fit under it). Type a limit above the upper estimate to keep the run from stopping at its limit unless a call outside the plan adds up; a lower limit, even the expected figure, can stop it there (exit 4, resumable with a higher total). This roster has not run, and none of its mechanisms has been measured. Price your task with `npm run dry` and get an explicit go before any paid run.
summary: Six judges and four proposers, all Chinese labs; three overseer rounds. An alternative route to plan-medium-council.
